newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian bourse traded volumes decline.
newsitem.headline: Estonian bourse traded volumes decline.

text.p: Volumes slipped on the Estonian bourse on Wednesday and some dealers said there was a bearish feeling among market players.
Large deals were made in Tallinna Pank and OTC stock Rakvere Meat plant shares, which both lost ground.
"Although trade was small Tallinna pank and Rakvere Meat plant both fell to where there seems to be the point of resistance and the market pushed them back up," one trader said.
"These stocks show that the market is not prepared to let them go too far, but on the whole the market still remains bearish," he added.
The Tallinn stock exchange index eased 0.54 percent to 187.05 on turnover of 24.3 million kroons on the official list.

Tallinna Pank eased to close down 4.33 kroons at 57.52 kroons after a turnover of 3.2 million kroons while Rakvere saw turnover of 7.7 million kroons of shares to close down 2.30 kroons to 12.10 kroons.
Rakevere has suffered after releasing 1996 results on Monday that were seen as disappointing.
Hansapank was the most active with 11.1 million kroons of shares traded to close up 2.20 kroons up at 181.70 kroons.
Some took Hansapank as a sign the market was not so gloomy.
"It does seem extraordinary that Hansapank has remained around the high of 1.70 kroons. This is a good sign for market confidence," another trader said.
Forekspank dipped 1.75 kroons to close at 143.75 kroons after turning over 4.9 million kroons.
Savings Bank turned over 2.4 million kroons to end 1.15 kroons weaker at 90.35 kroons.
Over-the-counter market trade was 10.9 million kroons.
Norma turned over 1.5 million kroons of shares to close up 1.20 kroons to 58.00 kroons.
It earlier announced January earnings of 7.8 million kroons.
"Norma's results looked good, but it is OTC company with unaudited results, so many dealers remain a little cautious and were not that interested," said one dealer.
